data.why: The interface has no upload widgets; it reads precomputed HIV-1 protease (1HSG/MK1) redocking, interaction, screening and molecular-dynamics outputs that already ship under data/processed/ and data/model_v2/ in the repository, so nothing needs to be copied or synthesized.

goals: Confirm that AutoDock Vina redocking reproduces the crystallographic MK1 pose within the 2 Å RMSD criterion before trusting the docking protocol for screening.
Inspect protein-ligand interaction geometry around the catalytic Asp25 dyad (hydrogen bonds, contacts, distances) for the validated reference complex.
Browse the virtual-screening consensus ranking to see which shortlisted compounds score best across ML prediction, Vina affinity, and drug-likeness/PAINS-Brenk alerts.
Compare shortlisted candidates' molecular-dynamics trajectories (ligand RMSD, H-bond persistence, contacts) to judge binding-pose stability over time.
Examine a candidate's 2D structure and RDKit descriptors (molecular weight, LogP, H-bond donors/acceptors) alongside its docking and MD metrics to build a prioritization rationale.
Download the packaged PDF/HTML report and manifest for the validated case study and shortlist for offline review.

review.summary: The docking half of the tree is solid: the goal and phases follow the README pipeline from redocking validation through interaction analysis, consensus ranking and export, and every screen I sampled matches its node. The tree still needs fixes before filing: the ML phase wrongly claims the classifier feeds the ranking, it reduces the README's major XAI validation and external-validation work to a quick skim, and a few nodes overstate what was seen (pose filters that don't actually change anything, a picker whose two entries can't be told apart).
